assets.action_name: 扶稳单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
assets.target_pose: 一手扶固定台面，重心转到左支持腿，另一脚可随时落地
assets.qa_observations: 通过视觉核对：同参考成年女性、黑马尾/白短袖/深灰裤/白鞋；完整双足和全身。左腿在前平踩支持，右腿在后以鞋尖轻触可落地；本人左掌接固定台面，右手空手下垂。固定桌腿和防滑底可见。桌面右端出画，但支持接触和固定结构清楚。仅视觉核对，非医疗验证。

attempts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one independent photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, a single person in one posture. The three input images are identity, clothing, hair, lighting and gray-blue studio background references only; do not copy their arm poses. Match the same adult East Asian woman with a black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve T-shirt, dark gray full-length pants, and plain white athletic shoes. Full body including both shoes, natural anatomy, soft studio light, matte gray-blue background and nonslip gray floor. Camera is a fixed oblique side view, she faces the right of frame. Step 01 of supported single-leg Romanian deadlift: she stands upright beside one stable fixed waist-high light gray worktop on her far side, left palm visibly resting on the top with authentic contact, left supporting leg bears the body weight with knee naturally unlocked and left foot firmly flat. Right foot is lightly resting beside and slightly behind the left foot in a position ready to lift backward; right arm hangs relaxed and empty at her side. Both legs and both shoes must be separately visible. The tabletop is fixed and solid with real legs, not a wheeled table. No weight or kettlebell. Keep the full tabletop support and full woman within frame with breathing room. One image, one posture, no panel layout, no labels, no text, no arrows, no watermark.

assets.action_name: 扶稳单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
assets.target_pose: 左支持膝轻屈、髋后折、躯干前倾、右腿自然后伸，台面扶持保持
assets.qa_observations: 通过视觉核对（第2次修订）：台面与s01固定位置/设计一致；同机位和人物尺度，前支持脚位置相近且平踩，支持膝轻屈；髋后折、躯干前倾、右腿自然后伸离地且与支持腿分开；左手保持台面支持，右手空手下垂，双足完整。初稿和第一次修订曾有台面横移，不采用。仅视觉核对，非医疗验证。

attempts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one independent photorealistic exercise demonstration photograph. assets.target_pose: 同一稳固扶手椅坐位，双脚接地，双手扶两侧扶手
assets.qa_observations: 通过视觉核对（构图修订后）：同参考人物、衣服、白鞋和灰蓝背景；双手接同一固定椅双扶手，臀坐椅面，双足平踩，椅有稳定木腿和防滑底、无轮。起身右前方无障碍。上方留白用于站起帧保持统一机位尺度。初稿坐位构图过紧不采用。仅视觉核对，非医疗验证。

assets.target_pose: 身体前移，借原扶手开始离椅，髋膝仍屈
assets.qa_observations: 通过视觉核对：固定椅设计、位置、尺度、双脚落地点与s01一致；身体前移，臀已明显离开椅面，髋膝仍屈曲，符合起身中段；近侧手接原扶手，远侧手接触扶手区域但有身体局部遮挡；脚跟仍落地，无迈步。仅视觉核对，非医疗验证。

assets.target_pose: 髋膝恢复舒适站姿并站稳，原椅和足位不变
